Chapter 7182: Grand Thousand Beast

Chapter 7182: Grand Thousand Beast

“High Heaven’s power.” Hao Cai and the others were stunned momentarily before regaining their composure.

Lightning bolts have been stopped successfully by Desolate Frontier. Alas, some were now within Heavenrealm. Where did they come from?

“We stand with the high heaven.” Sheng Shengxian spoke.

“Ridiculous, this must have been part of the plan a long time ago.” Hao Cai said: “Your founder, Senior An Ran, fights the high heaven, and don’t forget, you’re part of this world.”

“Though we dwell in the mortal world, we are messengers with the purpose of destroying it.” Sheng Shengxian said.

“Who created this ridiculous sect? Conspiring with the high heaven.” Wang Weiqiao asked.

“Conspiring? No, this is justice. And as for the founder of our faction? You will not live to find out.” Sheng Shengxian responded.

“We’ll see about that.” Wang Weiqiao raised his hatchet and said.

“Sure.” Di Ting exhaled a strange aura while listening to heaven and earth. The aura enveloped Grand Thousand World, becoming a vicious substance smothering and draining powers.

“Who has the power of the high heaven?” A flame erupted in Grand Thousand World and a bodhi tree rose from it.

It possessed tribulation flames from the high heaven, incinerating the enveloping aura.

“Bodhi Immortal.” Di Ting shouted: “Where did you get this flame?”

“The high heaven couldn’t kill me, so this flame is mine.” Bodhi Immortal declared.

“Just a newcomer from a foreign world, not enough to reach the apex.” Di Ting delivered a stomp.

“Is that so?” Bodhi roared and met the stomp directly.

On the other side, Sheng Shengxian’s group continued to attack. Guardian Alliance couldn’t afford to help Grand Thousand World due to the tribulations. Nonetheless, the natives weren’t afraid.

“Ninth Lady, to the death!” Hao Cai chose his foe.

“Have it your way.” Ninth Lady spewed out red strings like a spider, surrounding Hao Cai.

The latter snorted and turned his bamboo staff into stars. They shot beams through the strings, aiming at the source.

“Raa!” A colossal creature leaped up from Grand Thousand World, raising its tail. Halos appeared to stop Sheng Shengxian’s domain.

“Clank!” Energy spears manifested into reality and surged forward.

“You’re alive, Grand Thousand Beast.” Sheng Shengxian’s world tree summoned barriers to stop the spears.

Many were surprised to see this beast. It was once the lord of Grand Thousand World, an ancient primordial immortal.

Although it had lost to Empress Hong Tian, it maintained a strong relationship with Guardian Alliance. When Devouring Alliance attacked, its world received help from Guardian Alliance. Nonetheless, it was rumored to have fallen in battle.

“Die!” Lord of Fortress and the others began a ferocious attack.

As battles ensued everywhere, two enemies snuck into Desolate Frontier.

However, Immortal Emperor Hao Hai immediately spotted them: “Who?!”

The duo immediately ambushed him. He raised his sword but they shattered his sword dao and grievously injured him.

They didn’t relent and wanted to finish him. In this crucial moment, an impeccable slash swept through space and blocked their strikes.

Anyone watching would be filled with awe at the sword technique. The interceptor was none other than Violet Abyss Dao Lord. Alas, the dao lord still vomited blood.

“You’re from the nine worlds.” She recognized one of their auras.

“Gu Chun, no more hiding.” Immortal Emperor Hao Hai shouted.

One of them revealed himself - an ancient and austere cultivator with a pair of eyes capable of opening heavens and creating worlds - Immortal Emperor Gu Chun.

“Then you’re Skyshroud.” Immortal Emperor Hao Hai stared at the second combatant.

“How discerning.” Skyshroud revealed himself.

“Kill them!” Gu Chun immediately attacked.

Hao Hai and Violet Abyss were weakened from defending the wall, unable to perform at their peak. Thus, the relentless barrages could eventually become fatal.

“You two court death!” Empress Hong Tian had to leave the wall to Origin Heaven Emperor and came to save them.
